Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 marker: 1 from the moment you dance in a fairy ring until the dancing plague has rolled.

//RingDance: Feature 29/28 (plan sections 29 and 28): the hidden 0/1 MARKER of a dance. The fairy ring's 'Dance in the Ring' action writes +1 here and nothing else, and Tgr_HW_DancingPlague (gated on this at {1,1}) rolls the dancing plague once and writes -1 to put it back, so the action itself never touches the affliction stat and its one source stays a rolled STA on the affliction chassis (HarshWilds-Afflictions [ring-source]). BaseValue 0, no rate. Written by no other file.
